EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), TS_SUM(sale, 5))), MIN(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), sale), 1)), IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(invt, sale), 1)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Firms with substantial cumulative expensed R&D whose gross margins improve while inventory intensity falls earn higher subsequent returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The signal asks whether past innovation spending is translating into product-level pricing power without requiring more inventory capital. This combines the strong R&D-harvest theme with a concrete operating-capital discipline test rather than simply rewarding low investment.

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Fresh Plant Harvest Margin
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(ppegt, ppent))), MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(capx, at), 1))), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(oiadp, sale), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Firms with relatively fresh physical assets, declining capex intensity, and improving after-depreciation operating margins earn higher subsequent returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This targets firms exiting an investment cycle after renewing their asset base, not firms merely cutting capex because assets are old. Improving after-depreciation margins suggest the refreshed plant is now producing an economic payoff while reinvestment needs are easing.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Deleveraging With Maintenance Discipline
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at), 1))), IND_RANK(NEG(ABS(RATIO(SUB(capx, dp), at))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cash-profitable firms that reduce debt while keeping capex close to depreciation earn higher subsequent returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This improves on simple cash-profitable deleveraging by requiring that debt reduction is not achieved through obvious capex starvation or aggressive overinvestment. Capex near depreciation indicates maintenance discipline, making the cash generation more sustainable.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Acquisition Integration Leverage
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(aqc, 0), 3), at)), MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(xsga, sale), 1))), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Acquisition-intensive firms that achieve SG&A leverage and improving operating margins earn higher subsequent returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Rather than penalizing acquisitions broadly, this identifies cases where purchased growth appears to be integrated efficiently. Falling SG&A intensity alongside margin improvement suggests acquisitions are adding scale economies rather than organizational complexity.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Equity Funded Intangible Profit Fade
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(sstk, at)), MIN(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(intan, at), 1)), MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Profitable firms issuing equity to expand capitalized intangibles while operating margins fade earn lower subsequent returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: The signal targets overcredited growth financing: firms still look profitable, but they are raising equity and building intangible assets as margins roll over. The MIN structure prevents the high-score tail from being reached by issuance or intangible growth alone.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

VERDICT: flag

RATIONALE: This is largely a leg-swap on the archived "Cumulative RND Harvest No Capitalization" (same R&D-intensity and intangible-restraint gates, with the margin-improvement leg swapped for a cash-margin leg), and the added TS_COUNT(xrd,5) gate is both redundant with the COALESCE-based R&D intensity leg and nearly degenerate (a 0–5 integer that ranks as a mass of ties), while the fourth conjunctive gate plus oancf availability will further thin an already ~0.11 coverage tail.

---CRITIQUE RND Product Margin Inventory Release---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The three legs are economically distinct and the "innovation converting into pricing power without working-capital absorption" story is coherent, but it is close to a mechanical merge of two already-successful archive signals (cumulative R&D harvest and lean-inventory margin expansion), so the incremental information beyond those is uncertain.

---CRITIQUE Fresh Plant Harvest Margin---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Because MIN-conjunctions are not sign-symmetric, flipping all three legs of "Aged Asset Underinvestment Trap" genuinely tests a different tail rather than rediscovering it, and the post-investment-cycle harvest story is internally consistent; the main caveat is that low ppegt/ppent is contaminated by recent acquisitions and asset write-ups rather than purely "fresh" plant.

---CRITIQUE Deleveraging With Maintenance Discipline---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Replacing the interest-burden leg of "Cash Deleveraging Profit Harvest" with a non-monotonic maintenance-capex gate is a substantive rather than cosmetic change, but NEG(ABS((capx−dp)/at)) mechanically favors asset-light firms (where both terms are tiny) rather than firms genuinely reinvesting at replacement rate, so a capx/dp ratio centered at one would match the stated construct better.

---CRITIQUE Acquisition Integration Leverage---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is the complementary tail of the archived "Acquisition Integration Cost Creep" with two legs sign-flipped and no new economic content, and it takes the long side in high cumulative acquisition intensity — a well-documented negative predictor (acquirer/asset-growth anomaly) — so the expected positive sign is fighting the dominant known effect with only two soft margin gates.

---CRITIQUE Equity Funded Intangible Profit Fade---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: The construction stacks four conjunctive gates assembled almost entirely from previously tested and weak archive components (sstk issuance gate, intangible-build-with-margin-fade, high-then-fading margin), one of which already came in with the wrong sign, and the four-way MIN on sstk/intan will produce a sparse, unstable long-short tail; the residual signal is also likely just the well-known net-share-issuance anomaly.
